articles.title: Bending Spoons to buy collaboration tools maker Miro for $1.36B, 90% less than its 2022 valuation
articles.description: Bending Spoons is buying Miro for $1.36 billion, a huge dip in valuation for the workplace collaboration startup, which was valued at $17.5 billion in late 2021.
articles.raw_content: Bending Spoons is buying Miro for $1.36 billion, a huge dip in valuation for the workplace collaboration startup, which was valued at $17.5 billion in late 2021.
articles.selection_reason: A $17.5B collaboration unicorn selling for $1.36B is the clearest signal yet of how brutally 2021-era SaaS valuations are being reset in M&A.
articles.audience_value: Leaders get a concrete benchmark for exit expectations, down-round realities, and the rising role of PE-style acquirers like Bending Spoons in enterprise software.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: If you hold or are raising on a 2021 valuation, Miro's 90% haircut is the comp your board and acquirers will now cite.

articles.title: Jensen Huang explains why Nvidia will grow an astounding 70% next year
articles.description: Nvidia has its finger in every pie, and sees another year of plenty in its future, Jensen Huang says. But, he insists, its deals are not circular.
articles.raw_content: Nvidia has its finger in every pie, and sees another year of plenty in its future, Jensen Huang says. But, he insists, its deals are not circular.
articles.selection_reason: Nvidia's 70% growth forecast and Huang's defense against 'circular deal' accusations define the near-term trajectory of the entire AI capex cycle.
articles.audience_value: Executives can calibrate their own compute budgets, infrastructure bets, and bubble-risk assessments against the demand picture from the market's most central supplier.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: Nvidia's guidance is the leading indicator for whether the AI spending boom your strategy depends on continues or corrects.

articles.title: DeepMind researcher’s new AI lab nears $4bn valuation, reports say
articles.selection_reason: A brand-new lab from a DeepMind researcher nearing a $4B valuation shows frontier-AI talent alone still commands mega-round pricing.
articles.audience_value: Founders and CEOs see how investors are pricing elite AI talent and what it means for competing on hiring and fundraising against these neo-labs.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: Talent-driven valuations of this scale reshape the competitive landscape for both capital and senior AI hires that Leaders must recruit.

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic are making 10 times more revenue than all Chinese AI models combined, research group Rhodium says
articles.description: Rhodium Group's latest analysis of Chinese and U.S. AI companies also found that low revenue did not necessarily correspond with lower valuation.
articles.raw_content: Rhodium Group's latest analysis of Chinese and U.S. AI companies also found that low revenue did not necessarily correspond with lower valuation.
articles.selection_reason: Rhodium's finding that US labs out-earn all Chinese AI models 10-to-1 reframes the US-China AI race in commercial rather than technical terms.
articles.audience_value: Leaders gain a data-backed view of monetization gaps, geopolitical AI dynamics, and why valuation and revenue are decoupling in AI markets.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: Vendor selection, market-entry, and partnership decisions in AI should be informed by where the revenue—not just the benchmarks—actually lives.

articles.title: California Governor Gavin Newsom Issues A.I. Safety Executive Order
articles.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom ordered the state to develop recommendations on safety measures, including requiring companies to build a “kill switch,” amid mounting concerns.
articles.raw_content: “We’re going to speed up our work on substantial and responsible A.I. oversight before it’s too late,” Gov. Gavin Newsom of California said in a news release.
articles.selection_reason: California's executive order on AI safety, including a potential 'kill switch' mandate, is the first major state-level regulatory move in this cycle.
articles.audience_value: Executives can anticipate compliance obligations, product design constraints, and the regulatory template other states and countries may copy.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: Any company deploying AI in California will need to factor these forthcoming requirements into roadmap and risk planning now.
